mentions.name: gloss
mentions.description: A terminal renderer that displays markdown, source code, images, and chess and go game records in the terminal. Built for libghostty with fallback support on other terminals; installable via Homebrew (`brew install garlab/tap/gloss`).
mentions.source_excerpt: - https://github.com/garlab/gloss | `brew install garlab/tap/gloss`: render markdown, sources, images, chess and go (game) records in the terminal. It's built for libghostty but fallback on other terms.
